sentences.text: A review describes Klebsiella pneumoniae as a ubiquitous gut commensal that has become an opportunistic pathogen able to transition to a hypervirulent, multidrug-resistant form.
It is listed by the World Health Organization as a critical-priority pathogen.
A review reports that hypervirulent Klebsiella pneumoniae causes severe community-acquired infections including pyogenic liver abscess, meningitis, septic endophthalmitis and necrotising fasciitis.

That review states that since the first reports from Taiwan in the 1980s hypervirulent strains have spread globally, with convergent multidrug-resistant strains documented in Asia, North America and Europe.
Hypervirulence is attributed there largely to plasmid-encoded factors, including the hypermucoid regulators rmpA and rmpA2 and siderophores such as aerobactin and salmochelin.
